```text
When the cards are face up, Hero can
calculate his exact equity against his
opponent's hand. Since this is never the
case in c-bet situations, Hero must
estimate how good his equity is likely to
be against his opponent's calling range to
the c-bet.

Equity can at times be an even more
crucial factor than board texture. Just as
some boards can render a light c bet
+EV without any equity at all; having
sufficient equity can make a c-bet good
on any texture at all. In fact, equity can
be an absolute factor in that if Hero has
enough of it, then betting can
```

```text
always be assessed against Villain's
calling range, not the full range that
Villain sees the flop with. Hero's equity
in the hand only matters if Villain
continues to the c-bet. Hero has no need
to hit any of his outs if he's already won
the pot!
```
